description.text: Leading strategy and developer ecosystem at Fireworks AI, the inference platform built by the team behind PyTorch and Gemini. Building full-cycle AI: the right model to the right context at the right time. Everyone else is betting on the model. We're building the platform that makes every model deliver.

Helping Startups and Entrepreneurs accelerate innovation with Artificial Intelligence at Microsoft

subComponents.title: Global Head AI/ML Startups and VC
subComponents.caption: Jul 2022 - Aug 2023 · 1 yr 1 mo

description.text:
Launched Global Generative AI Accelerator reaching 1,200 startup companies
Author of many pieces of strategic content for AWS including  an MLOps Ebook with top tier VCs (Sequoia, Madrona, and AIFund) and as an editor of the State of AI Report.
Consistently rated in the top 5% of AWS employees year over year.
Hired and developed a team of international AI/ML experts.
Built out AI/ML segmentation, propensity model, and training for engaging with ML startups on AWS.

subComponents.title: Principal Business Development Manager AWS ML / AI
subComponents.caption: Oct 2020 - Sep 2022 · 1 yr 11 mos

description.text:
Led all of the Software and Hardware development across US, Japan, and Italy. Diligence and integration of 3 acquisitions including Checkout Free (Italy, 15 people), Explorer.ai (7), and Deep Magic (Patent and IP).
Key Achievements:
•	Launched autonomous checkout solution (Amazon Go for everyone else) deployed at multiple client brick & mortar stores using a camera-based computer vision system with deep learning technologies using TensorFlow.
•	Grew the team from 20 to 125+ FTE., sourced and actively recruited talent in computer vision, deep learning, robotics, video, camera, big data engineering, research, data science, project management, and operationsors.
•	Modernized an on-premise solution with limited test infrastructure in Microsoft Azure by building out secure and global site reliability, cloud infrastructure, and IT functions from scratch. Leveraged technologies like Cloud Identity-Aware Proxy, Google Cloud Platform, and Qubole (Data Lake).
•	Provided leadership and direction to a microservice architecture, secure authentication/authorization, rapid prototyping with Retool and Rockset, and data set versioning using DVC as well as CI/CD pipelines, ticketing, documentation, paging, and release.

experiences.title: VP Technology and GM @ SiriusXM / Automatic Labs
experiences.subtitle: Sirius XM Radio Inc. . undefined
experiences.caption: Apr 2017 - Jun 2018 · 1 yr 2 mos

description.text:
* Responsible for hiring, budgets, vendor negotiations, consultants, systems security, API/SLA reliability, and general management of emerging business unit
* Architected embedded apps platform using ReactJS using native Android and iOS components with major partners including Best Buy and various car dealerships
* Designed and shipped real-time data insights using serverless computing and Apache Spark for both consumer products and enterprise partners

* Pivotal in leading acquisition of Automatic Labs by SiriusXM for 115 Million
* Supported due diligence with many prospective buyers including extensive information security and compliance reviews
* Shipped $10+ million dollar connected insurance program with major insurance carrier using millions of real-time events to proactively create customer discounts

* Grew Automatic Labs from 12 to 88 FTE
* Launched Automatic Pro connected car cellular adapter, which is the first adapter in its category to pass major security audits including from the DHS
* Shipped usage-based, per mile, and teen insurance programs with enterprise-class information storage and policies on time for USAA and Liberty Mutual

* Launched "App Store for Your Car" with first of its kind connected car developer platform and live API enabling hundreds of connected car apps
* Pioneered use of microservices and modern data infrastructure for Automatic by scaling from a monolithic architecture  to hundreds of distributed servers
* Designed software and security development process focusing on 100% code review, continuous delivery, and test-driven methodologies

* Founded and led data science team at Rdio a music service acquired by Pandora
* Lead developer for new recommendations and stations API/Services integrating partner data and services for 30+ million tracks and millions of users
* Delivered new stations, on-time with tremendous success including being rated “Bestmodo” by Gizmodo and increasing station usage more than 500%
Built real-time, multi-threaded audio engine for iOS

Mobile development

* Built real time, multi threaded audio engine for iOS.
* Cross platform mobile development in C# (Windows Phone, Android, iPhone)
* Built mobile integration test suite using computer vision and audition, and unit tests
* Talks on pattern recognition and music recommendation

* C++ engineer on popular FlipShare Desktop and FlipShare TV software shipped on the popular Flip Video cameras
* Improved build system, brought forth new tools, and reduced build times 
* Lead engineer for the second release of FlipShareTV, a media set-top box, "Share to Twitter", and the final International release (French, English, German, and Spanish), collaborating with teams in Romania and Denmark
* Cross-Platform development for both Mac and Windows in C++ using Qt

Software Developer for Media Composer Professional Video Editing Software and next generation Video Hardware

    * Multimedia application development in C++ under a large legacy code base
    * Designed new application level audio features for major releases including UI
    * Realtime and kernel debugging

Open Source developer for the GAMERA Project involving teaching a computer how to read printed symbols like ancient text and sheet music, which are historically difficult for a computer to understand

    * Cross platform developing in C++ and Python (Windows, Mac, Linux)
    * Researching new techniques for image processing and pattern recognition
    * Implemented DSP methods, filters, and fast flexible geometric matching
     * Automated testing with documentation and batch building under multiple compilers
